pocket.nusmp.clockwork_vault.boss.death: The Chronarch winds down, and for one breath every clock in the Vault shows the same, true hour.
pocket.nusmp.clockwork_vault.boss.intro: Every clock in the Vault strikes the same second. The Chronarch unwinds from the centre of the hall.
pocket.nusmp.clockwork_vault.lore: Artificers who tried to build a vault that no thief could outwait. They succeeded: the Vault still ticks, and it will wait for you, and wait, and wait.
pocket.nusmp.clockwork_vault.name: Clockwork Vault of Hours
pocket.nusmp.crimson_abattoir.boss.death: Vorgrim laughs once, wetly, and the arena is quiet.
pocket.nusmp.crimson_abattoir.boss.intro: The red rivers slow on the ceiling. Vorgrim steps out of the shadow behind the dais, already smiling.
pocket.nusmp.crimson_abattoir.lore: A cult's arena where every wound was an offering. The rivers on its ceilings are not water, and the floors remember every one who bled on them.
pocket.nusmp.crimson_abattoir.name: Crimson Abattoir
pocket.nusmp.drowned_observatory.boss.de: The tide pulls back from the Leviathan and does not return.
pocket.nusmp.drowned_observatory.boss.in: Every river on the ceiling turns once, as if the sea were looking down. The Leviathan unfolds out of the dark water.
pocket.nusmp.drowned_observatory.lore: Astronomers read the stars through the sea until the sea rose to read them back. Rivers run along the ceilings of its halls, as if the tide had forgotten which way is down.
pocket.nusmp.drowned_observatory.name: Drowned Observatory
pocket.nusmp.ember_sanctum.boss.death: The furnace-light goes out of the Smith-King's eyes.
pocket.nusmp.ember_sanctum.boss.intro: The anvils fall silent. Something vast stands up from the forge.
pocket.nusmp.ember_sanctum.lore: A smith-kingdom that fed its furnaces with its own sun-stone, buried with its king still at the anvil. The air tastes of cold iron and old coals.
pocket.nusmp.ember_sanctum.name: Sanctum of the Ashen Forge
pocket.nusmp.frozen_cathedral.boss.death: The Archon's heart, a lump of blue ice, cracks and runs like water.
pocket.nusmp.frozen_cathedral.boss.intro: The frozen bells ring once. The Archon rises from the choir stalls with a sound like ice splitting.
pocket.nusmp.frozen_cathedral.lore: A choir sang the winter in and never sang it out. The nave is still full of kneeling frost, and the bells hang, frozen mid-note, over a vault no thaw has touched.
pocket.nusmp.frozen_cathedral.name: Cathedral of the Silent Winter
pocket.nusmp.gilded_crypt.boss.death: Anhetep's mouth opens one last time, and the sun he swallowed comes out of it, and goes.
pocket.nusmp.gilded_crypt.boss.intro: The gold in the walls dims, all at once. Something very old unwraps itself on the dais.
pocket.nusmp.gilded_crypt.lore: A desert dynasty swallowed the sun to keep its dead from rotting, and was in turn swallowed by the dunes. The gold is all still here. So is the patience of whatever swallowed the sun.
pocket.nusmp.gilded_crypt.name: Gilded Crypt of the Sun-Eater
pocket.nusmp.mirrored_halls.boss.death: The mirrors go dark one by one. The last one shows only you.
pocket.nusmp.mirrored_halls.boss.intro: A hundred mirrors show a hundred kings. One of them is not a reflection, and he is looking at you.
pocket.nusmp.mirrored_halls.lore: A court that ruled by showing every visitor a better version of themselves, until no one could tell the visitors from the reflections. The King is whichever one is not you.
pocket.nusmp.mirrored_halls.name: Halls of the Reflected King
pocket.nusmp.radiant_basilica.boss.death: Auriel bows her head, and the light she wore settles on the floor like snow.
pocket.nusmp.radiant_basilica.boss.intro: Every lamp in the Basilica burns white at once. Auriel looks at you with eyes that have never closed, and does not yet decide.
pocket.nusmp.radiant_basilica.lore: A basilica that kept its lamps lit for a thousand years after its congregation was gone. Its seraph never fell, and has been waiting ever since for someone to be worthy of the vault.
pocket.nusmp.radiant_basilica.name: Radiant Basilica of the Unfallen
pocket.nusmp.starfall_archive.boss.death: The eyes of the Archivist close, one after another, and the last page is written.
pocket.nusmp.starfall_archive.boss.intro: Every book in the Archive turns its pages at once. Oriel opens, one eye after another, to read you.
pocket.nusmp.starfall_archive.lore: A library built where a star fell, by scribes who copied the star's light onto paper until the paper burned. Gravity is a suggestion here; the books float, and so do you.
pocket.nusmp.starfall_archive.name: Starfall Archive
pocket.nusmp.stormspire_aerie.boss.death: The storm leaves Valkarin all at once, and the spire is very quiet.
pocket.nusmp.stormspire_aerie.boss.intro: Lightning walks along the spire. Valkarin lowers himself from the roof of the world.
pocket.nusmp.stormspire_aerie.lore: The sky riders built their roost on a spire of stone that no longer remembers the ground. Their halls have forgotten weight; their guardians have not forgotten their lances.
pocket.nusmp.stormspire_aerie.name: Stormspire Aerie
pocket.nusmp.umbral_catacombs.boss.death: The pact tears itself in two, and Nekrathul is the thing between the halves.
pocket.nusmp.umbral_catacombs.boss.intro: The floor and the ceiling trade places in your mind. A voice that has not spoken in a thousand years says: another contract.
pocket.nusmp.umbral_catacombs.lore: A house that bargained with a devil and kept the bargain too well. Its catacombs run upside down in places, because the devil asked for a floor and was given a ceiling.
pocket.nusmp.umbral_catacombs.name: Umbral Catacombs of the Pact
pocket.nusmp.venom_hive.boss: Vess, Queen of the Hollow Hive
pocket.nusmp.venom_hive.boss.death: The hum goes out of the hive, a note at a time, until there is only silence.
pocket.nusmp.venom_hive.boss.intro: The hive stops humming. Something very large shifts in the wax, and many small things turn to face you.
pocket.nusmp.venom_hive.lore: An empire of insects that outlived its builders and its own queen's patience. The hive's rivers are sweet and wrong, its floors are wax, and it is always, always listening.
pocket.nusmp.venom_hive.name: Venom Hive of the Hollow Queen
pocket.nusmp.verdant_reliquary.boss.deat: The Thornmother's leaves fall, one by one, and do not grow back.
pocket.nusmp.verdant_reliquary.boss.intr: The roots of the reliquary draw tight. A voice like creaking timber says: you may take nothing.
pocket.nusmp.verdant_reliquary.lore: The elves who raised this house of relics let the forest grow over them rather than leave. Roots have become its corridors, and the garden still guards what the gardeners buried.
pocket.nusmp.verdant_reliquary.name: Verdant Reliquary
